name: Misasagi Inori
source: A patron of "YuKuRu" and an old acquaintance of [url=/c66131]Inaho Shin[/url]. She works at a nursery school. In her free time, she maintains an old chapel that lies on a hill in Fujikawa. She likes riddles and lights up immediately when they're alluded to.  Her catchphrase is "Nazo Nazo Tai~" but she's too embarrassed to sound out the end; it's an old habit of hers. [spoiler]Her real name is Sagisawa Inori; she is married to [url=/c11657]Sagisawa Isshu[/url] and is implied to have a child. [/spoiler]
